title: coronopus pectinatus
intro: Coronopus pectinatus, commonly known as Land Cress, is a type of cruciferous plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia, known for its edible leaves and stems. The health benefits of Coronopus pectinatus include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-bacterial properties.
